name: Houjou Marina
source: A brilliant (trouble-making?) international agent. Even though she boasts a 99% success rate, she is alienated by various officials because she wreaks havoc wherever she goes. Her best friend since ages ago is Yayoi, from the Katsuragi Private Detective Agency.
